workflow.name: archon-build-queue
workflow.description:
The build queue: takes intake's triaged work items to a reviewed, ready pull
request and stops only for decisions that belong to a person. Each run claims the
best waiting item with intake's claim, or the one the number input names. One
agent routes it (and proves a bug's symptom first) and launches archon-ship from a
brief, or marks a pull request already reviewed Ready and green ready without
another round; one agent answers how that round ended; and after several rounds that each
found new defects, one agent decides whether to ask the scope question instead of
running another. A clear case acts on its own. Anything unclear pauses as one
attention item whose answer is a declared choice; the ruling is written into the
issue body as a dated "Current scope" section. Every decision is recorded on the
item's work item.

Use when: a trigger binding the operator installed starts it (see the SDLC pack
README, "Build queue").
NOT for: triaging an item (archon-intake), delivering one item by hand
(archon-ship), or merging (archon-merge-queue).

repo_host.description: The forge host of the repository whose work items the queue builds.

repo_path.description: The owner/name path of that repository.

number.description: The issue to build. Empty claims the waiting item that sorts first. A number claims that item, and refuses the run with the reason when it cannot: it has no work item, another run holds it, or it does not wait for the build queue.

retriage_as.description: The maintainer login a blocked item's re-triage is requested as. Set, a run that names no item also revisits the blocked items: one agent judges which no longer look blocked, and those get archon-triage and an intake run with that label event. Empty revisits nothing.

round_limit.description: After this many rounds since the item's scope last changed, the answer to a round that ends wanting another also judges whether the rounds converge.
